post.caption: "The market's gone quiet." Austin's own permit record says: in one trade, yes. Roofing is running 8% below its 11-month average. HVAC dipped from July but is still 19% above its own average — a down month inside a strong year. And solar just did 224 permits, up 138% month over month, its biggest month in the twelve we hold (source: City of Austin Issued Construction Permits (Socrata), as of 2026-08-01). We can't tell you why from a permit count, and we're not going to guess.
